title: Content hash excludes cosmetics
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Content hash scope
  Scenario: Name and byline do not change hash
    Given identical text, voice_id, and tts_backend
    When name or byline changes
    Then computeContentHash returns the same value
  Scenario: Text voice or backend changes hash
    Given a baseline hash
    When text, voice_id, or tts_backend changes
    Then the hash changes
```

## Implementation brief
1. embed/src/generator/hash.ts — hash = normalize(text)+voice_id+tts_backend.
2. Tests in embed/tests/hash.test.ts.
